description: This file defines an object called CalculationHistory that manages an in-memory calculation history for a calculator application. It provides methods to add calculations, retrieve the history, and clear it.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a calculation expression and result to the history, maintaining a maximum of 100 entries. Ignores blank expressions.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of all calculation entries, most recent first.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the history.
